description:
Astro Vitals is a passionate and innovative student team from Benchmark Junior School, GT Road Campus, Islamabad, Pakistan, participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge.

Our team is driven by curiosity, creativity, and a shared passion for science, technology, space exploration, and innovation. Through our project, Astro Vitals – Health Monitoring System, we aim to explore innovative ways of combining healthcare technology with space science to address health-monitoring challenges.
